# U Tube screenshots

These PNGs are unchanged captures of the running **U Tube** Android app on device (`RMX3371`), replacing earlier captures.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `v4-onboarding.png` | First-launch interactive onboarding welcome screen with obsidian & frosted pearl-sheet layout. |
| `v4-onboarding-style.png` | Onboarding theme, accent color, and Liquid Glass surface customization with live interactive preview. |
| `v4-home.png` | Home screen feed with Liquid Glass bottom navigation bar. |
| `v4-search.png` | Search results screen with live filters and Liquid Glass chrome. |
| `v4-playback.png` | Watch screen during video playback. |
| `v4-you.png` | You & Library screen with local history, playlists, and queue cards. |
